summary_note: Section 5.23 decomposition. F and U differ by optimizer resets alone (same seed, same initial model, same data schedule, same genome - pinned by a built-in check), so F_vs_U measures the cost of discarding Adam's moments. U and R differ by whether the architecture changed mid-flight, so U_vs_R measures the cost of the rebuild itself. Negative means the first-named run won.
